title: DL$^3$M: A Vision-to-Language Framework for Expert-Level Medical Reasoning through Deep Learning and Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2512.13742v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Medical image classifiers detect gastrointestinal diseases well, but they do not explain their decisions. Large language models can generate clinical text, yet they struggle with visual reasoning and often produce unstable or incorrect explanations. This leaves a gap between what a model sees and the type of reasoning a clinician expects. We introduce a framework that links image classification with structured clinical reasoning. A new hybrid model, MobileCoAtNet, is designed for endoscopic images and achieves high accuracy across eight stomach-related classes. Its outputs are then used to drive reasoning by several LLMs. To judge this reasoning, we build two expert-verified benchmarks covering causes, symptoms, treatment, lifestyle, and follow-up care. Thirty-two LLMs are evaluated against these gold standards. Strong classification improves the quality of their explanations, but none of the models reach human-level stability.

translated_title: DL$^3$M：通过深度学习与大语言模型实现专家级医学推理的视觉到语言框架
translated_abstract: 医学图像分类器能够很好地检测胃肠道疾病，但无法解释其决策。大语言模型可以生成临床文本，但它们在视觉推理方面存在困难，且常常产生不稳定或不正确的解释。这在模型“看到”的内容与临床医生期望的推理类型之间留下了空白。我们提出了一个将图像分类与结构化临床推理相连接的框架。我们设计了一种面向内窥镜图像的新型混合模型MobileCoAtNet，在八个胃部相关类别上实现了高准确率。其输出随后被用于驱动多个大语言模型进行推理。为了评估这些推理，我们构建了两个经专家验证的基准，涵盖病因、症状、治疗、生活方式和随访护理。共有三十二个大语言模型针对这些金标准进行了评估。强大的分类能力提升了其解释的质量，但没有任何模型达到人类水平的稳定性。
tldr: 该论文提出DL³M框架，通过新型混合模型MobileCoAtNet对内窥镜图像进行高精度分类，并将其输出与大语言模型的结构化临床推理相结合，同时建立了两个专家验证的基准来评估32个LLM的医学推理质量。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes DL³M, a framework that achieves high-accuracy endoscopic image classification via a novel hybrid model MobileCoAtNet and links its outputs to structured clinical reasoning by large language models, establishing two expert-verified benchmarks to evaluate the medical reasoning quality of 32 LLMs.
